environment: Python 3.10 or later (requires-python >=3.10; CI tests 3.10 and 3.13), managed with uv (uv.lock, no package build). Run the tests with: uv run --frozen pytest (tests/unit and tests/integration). Cut each work item's branch from origin/main inside the worktree the session runs in; never create or remove a worktree.
design: A comment on the work item's GitHub issue.
